path_branch_filters: none: apps/packages/lockfile/OpenAPI/workflows and all other changes included

android.secrets: not forwarded; signing secrets only in dependent build job

same_commit_basis: Same-repository relative reusable workflow selected from caller commit; github context is caller; both checkouts pin github.sha
limits: Structural parse/assertions only, not actionlint or hosted Actions execution. No push, release, branch protection or secrets changes.

hard_dependency_outcomes.quality_failure: build skipped by needs default success condition
hard_dependency_outcomes.quality_success: build eligible, still subject to its own setup/build/sign/verify steps
